what.text: This page follows refugees from Colombia living in Ecuador, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22420 Colombian refugees in Ecuador, 28.1% of all refugees from Colombia.
Ecuador is the largest host of Colombian refugees, followed by Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1976 to 2025, with the FARC, M-19, ELN and EPL among the opponents.
It records the conflict at war level in some of those years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1981 at 50 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 264255, at the end of 2007, the main year of displacement in the data, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ecuador.
These are year-end totals for Ecuador only, reported to UNHCR.
